purpose: Turn autonomous engineering work into bounded, evidence-driven experiments with lineage, controlled resource allocation, evidence-only opportunity discovery, and verified cross-repo learning.

experiment_lineage.comparison_rule: competitors must share repository, exact baseline, and measurement contract
experiment_lineage.promotion_rule: only COMPLETE + VERIFIED_PASS + no safety violations may compete for promotion
experiment_lineage.tie_rule: within measurement tolerance produces NO_CLEAR_WINNER; do not invent a tiebreaker

hypothesis_competition.candidate_count_semantics: default planning bound only; actual execution still requires Agent Action Guard and resource scheduling

resource_scheduler.non_ready_rule: Agent Action Guard state other than READY is not schedulable

opportunity_sweeper.position: downstream of live triage, roadmaps, reality checks, throughput optimization, and reinvestment planning
opportunity_sweeper.question: Which already-evidenced gap can be converted into a cheap, reversible, measurable experiment now?
opportunity_sweeper.ranking: P0-P6 priority then explicit evidence breadth; never invented ROI/probability/severity/percent-complete

pattern_distillation.domain_rule: domain-specific product requirements never transfer across projects
pattern_distillation.promotion_state: PORTFOLIO_PATTERN_CANDIDATE is evidence for a governed proposal, not automatic adoption

existing_gates_preserved: product repository architecture and roadmap authority
pre-change risk and verified learning retrieval
forbidden: treating experiment count as product success
comparing candidates with different baselines or measurement contracts
inventing a resource budget or treating missing capacity as available
fuzzy cross-repo generalization of product behavior
transferring domain-specific product requirements between projects
allowing the experiment author to substitute for independent verification
using fairness to preempt higher P0-P6 priority work
